integrity: The calculation uses a complete deterministic enumeration of the defined finite simplicial complex and its full graph automorphism group. Self-review does not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact rational equivariant module for the single finite Heawood matching complex; no integral module splitting, other graphs, or equivariant homotopy type is asserted.
title: Full \(\operatorname{Aut}(H)\)-module of the Heawood matching complex
